name: msg91-otp-password-login
changes: Fixed production CSP so MSG91 OTP provider and reCAPTCHA can load; added provider fallback and corrected server-side MSG91 access-token JSON verification.
Existing customer and listener accounts now sign in with password only; SMS OTP login for existing accounts is disabled
New customer and listener registrations use the MSG91 OTP Widget custom Web SDK with the configured default SMS template
Forgot-password recovery uses MSG91 OTP and server-side access-token verification before allowing a password reset
MSG91 OTP Widget helper is shared by customer and listener PWAs and cached in the new v8.9.12 service-worker caches
Legacy Fast2SMS/Twilio OTP sending is disabled in the Render blueprint for the active authentication flow
notes: Set MSG91_AUTH_KEY on the backend/Render service before production OTP verification will complete
MSG91_AUTH_KEY is the private account Authkey and is different from the OTP Widget WEMETWEB client token
Current UI accepts 4 to 6 OTP digits so it works with the current 4-digit widget and remains compatible if the widget is changed to 6 digits later
